hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+-rf|rm\s+-r\s+/|DROP\s+TABLE|TRUNCATE|--force|--hard"; then echo "BLOCKED: Destructive command detected. Ask the user for explicit confirmation first." >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then EXT="${FILE##*.}"; case "$EXT" in ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css|scss|md|html) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; fi'
